# Vendored brand books

Two public design-system guides, rendered to plain text with one sentence or one table row per line. Every line
keeps its upstream file and line in the `upstream` column, so each rule in `../spec/` traces back to the published
page. `make_sources.py` rebuilds both files from clones at the commits below (prose lines are listed in that script,
quoted verbatim without inline code markup or link targets; token tables are read from the upstream data files).

## `govuk/source.tsv` (G1-G85) and `govuk/wcag.tsv` (W1-W7)

- GOV.UK Design System, https://design-system.service.gov.uk/, from `alphagov/govuk-design-system` at commit
  `88066fd8759ff83ac0b46e98b256e4c507746fc4` (17 November 2026): the Colour page with its data file
  (`data/colours.json`), Typeface, Type scale, Spacing, Links and the Button component.
- Licence: the content is © Crown copyright, available under the
  [Open Government Licence v3.0](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/), which
  allows copying, adapting and publishing with attribution; the repository's code is MIT. The GOV.UK crown logo and
  the GDS Transport typeface are not covered by those licences: neither is reproduced here (the typeface appears only
  as a font-family name that the checker reads).
- WCAG 2.2, https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/ (W3C Recommendation; copyright © 2020-2024 World Wide Web Consortium),
  used under the W3C Document License: success criterion 1.4.3 with its three exceptions, and the definitions of
  large scale, contrast ratio and relative luminance (the luminance definition is condensed to one line). GOV.UK's
  colour page points to 1.4.3, so the GOV.UK spec reads these lines.

## `uswds/source.tsv` (U1-U63)

- U.S. Web Design System, https://designsystem.digital.gov/, from `uswds/uswds-site` at commit
  `af13d80f071c3d897bee422f51954d9d7d156474` (Using color, theme color tokens, spacing units, font size, using type,
  font family, Button guidance and the token data files) and `uswds/uswds` at commit
  `029d6d792241b3b4107a630590a27ee951a152b5` (the system colour tokens, one line per colour family).
- Licence: a work of the United States government, in the public domain within the United States, with copyright
  and related rights waived worldwide through CC0 1.0. Using it implies no endorsement.

Nothing else from either project is copied: the pages in `../data/` are generated by `../pages.py` with our own
markup and text, using only these token values and class names.
